finding.headline: "The 'Bad Mother' Shame Mama"
finding.problem: "One sentence from my aunty and I felt 2 inches tall. I hide the formula tins. I laugh when they praise 'natural mummies' and die inside."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 25-yr-old diaspora mum who formula-feeds; at a family party an aunty muttered "she's not fit to be a mother"; she hasn't told anyone she's not BF.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Marketing angle for C1 — "Unashamed, Mama: Dropping the 'Good Mother = Breastfeeding' Lie."". Verdict: PASSES (23/25)..
